paragraphs: R' Yishmael son of Yaakov son of Acha.
Mentioned in Shabbat, chapter 4, halakhah 2; R' Yose son of R' Chanina reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ד ה״ב explicitly gives Shabbat chapter 4 halakhah 2. The format suggests Jerusalem Talmud but no corpus is stated or independently checked.

The full three-generation heading chain remains without adding titles to Yaakov or Acha. בר׳ in the reporting name means son of R' Chanina. Yose reports Yishmael; all three personal title abbreviations remain R'.
